title: Pack
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Use this API to mark an order item as being packed.
html:
Request Address

POST/order/fulfill/pack
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
packReqObjectYesrequest body
  pack_order_listObject[]YesBatch size is limited to 20，Orders that need to be packed，Sub-orders of the same order will be processed together
    order_item_listNumber[]Yesorder_item_ids that need to be packed
    order_idNumberYesorder that need to be packed
  delivery_typeStringYesdropship
  shipment_provider_codeStringNoIf it is a local store (TFs), this field cannot be transferred; If it is a cross-border store must pass (NTFS); This field cannot be transferred to DBS orders (including local stores and cross-border stores) If you want to get the available values, you can call the <a href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api?path=%2Forder%2Fshipment%2Fproviders%2Fget' target='_brank'>getshipmentprovider</a> API
  shipping_allocate_typeStringYesIf you want to get the available values, you can call the <a href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/api?path=%2Forder%2Fshipment%2Fproviders%2Fget' target='_brank'>getshipmentprovider</a> API

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resultObjectYesresp body
  dataObjectYesresp data
    pack_order_listObject[]Yespack order process result list
      order_item_listObject[]Yesorder item pack result
        order_item_idNumberYesorderItemId
        msgStringYeserrMsg when item_err_code!=0
        item_err_codeStringYes0=success other=error code，The final processing result of the order
        tracking_numberStringYestracking_number
        shipment_providerStringYesshipment_provider
        package_idStringYespackage_id
        retryBooleanYesDetermine if the package can be retried
      order_idNumberYesorder id
  successBooleanYesIf this is true, it doesn't mean that everything is processed successfully. It is necessary to judge that the item_err_code in orders is equal to 0 to determine that the processing is successful. Otherwise, if this is false, this batch must be unsuccessful.
  error_codeStringYesexists when success is false
  error_msgStringYesexists when success is false

Error Codes

CodeDescriptionSolution
E6SYSTEM_ERRORsystem is busy now ,pls try later
E1003E1003_3PL_ALLOCATION_FAIL3pl allocation failed
E40011RPC_ERRORsystem is busy now ,pls try later
E700000PACKAGE_STATUS_NOT_ALLOW_TO_OPcurrent package status not allow to operation
E700001DBS_SHIPMENT_PROVIDER_CODE_NOT_EXITSshipment provider code not exits
E700004 PARAM_ILLEGALparam illegal
E700013OP_NOT_SUPPORToperation is no support
E700016NOT_AVAILABLE_NTFS_3PLseller not available 3pl , pls contact us to subscription 3pl
E700017PARAM_IS_NULLparam can't be null
E700018 PARAM_SIZE_ERRORparam size not match
E700019PARAM_MIN_ERRORparam min not match
E700020ORDER_ITEM_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_BELONG_DIGITALorder item not found or not belong to digital
E700021 ORDER_NOT_FOUNDorder not found
E700022BATCH_SIZE_OUT_OF_LIMITbatch size out of limit
E700023 PICKUP_IN_STORE_NO_SUPPORTpickup in store order no allow to operation
E700024GET_LOCK_FAILEDfailed get lock,pls try later
E700025ORDER_ITEM_NOT_FOUNDorder item not found
E700026FO_ITEM_NOT_ALLOW_TO_PACKitem current status not allow to pack
E700027NOT_SUPPORT_FBL_TO_PACKDoes not support FBL order to pack
E700028NOT_SUPPORT_PACK_UP_IN_STORE_TO_PACKDoes not support pickup_in_store order to pack
E700029 ITEM_MUST_BELONG_SAME_WAREHOUSEitem must belong same warehouse
E700030 NOT_SUPPORT_DG_SERVICE_TO_PACKdigital or service order not need to pack
E700031 ITEM_NOT_READY_TO_FULFILLitem not ready to fulfill
E700032SELLER_NOT_FOUNDcan't found seller
E700033TRANSFERRING_WAREHOUSE_PROVIDERtransferringWarehouseCode cannot found
